answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops fake identities. A newcomer needs a sponsor locking 60 units; fraud slashes both, and a referral graph exposes borrowed names. Idle standing decays 5% per epoch, so a raven as a decoy bleeds value, while honest work restores it like nectar. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors, 60,000 units. An honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards; a velvet ribbon proves nothing without the stake.
